nodes.long_description:
1.Put a clip and dumbbell at the end of two threads
2. Attach tape to the end of the thread
3. Hold the tape and attach it to the inside of the bottle
4. Attach the magnet to the inside of the lid
5. Close the lid
6. Press the red button to turn on the power
7. Move the train with the arrow button
nodes.short_description: In virtual reality, we use magnets, clips, and maglev trains to learn current and magnetic field magnetic levitation

nodes.long_description: "Dive into the realm of realistic experiments through Virtual Reality (VR). Experience the excitement of conducting actual reactions in a risk-free digital laboratory. Mix substances, observe genuine changes, and engage with lifelike molecular structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
